title: Jeepney driver tests positive for drugs ahead of Undas in La Union

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A jeepney driver in La Union tested positive for illegal drug use during a surprise screening of public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers and conductors in the Ilocos Region on Thursday, Oct. 29. The screening covered 111 transport workers as authorities intensified road safety measures ahead of Undas. The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Region 1 said the driver yielded a positive result during the initial screening conducted under Oplan Harabas, an anti-drug operation aimed at preventing drug-impaired driving among public transport workers.
